title.en: The One With the White Rose

description.es: Fina le dice a Isidro que vivan juntos, e Isidro acepta. Isidro dice que su flor debería ser una rosa blanca. Mientras Fina y Marta flirtean en el jardín, ven que Isidro ha muerto.
description.en: Fina tells Isidro that they should live together, and Isidro agrees. Isidro says that their flower should be a white rose. As Fina and Marta are flirting in the garden, they see that Isidro has died.
